_meta.description: Layer and track definitions, capability ladder, world evolution arc

sequence.answers: What does the player learn, in what order?
sequence.output: A topic (e.g. Cellular Automata) placed in a QFEP phase, with ordered maps
sequence.notes: 19 spine sequences form the canonical learning journey. Each maps to exactly one QFEP phase.

map.output: A VR level on a 3-layer grid (structure / utilities / interactables)
map.notes: Maps are the playable unit. Each sequence has 1+ maps. The grid is 11x11x3 tiles.

track.answers: What evolves across the whole journey?
track.output: One beat per sequence per track — 5 parallel narrative threads
track.notes: Tracks are the connective tissue. Each track answers a different dramatic question that spans all 19 sequences.

qfep_phase.answers: What kind of understanding is this?
qfep_phase.output: A theoretical lens on each sequence — Order, Oscillation, Entropy, Emergence, Edge of Chaos, Becoming
qfep_phase.notes: The QFEP (Queer Free Energy Principle) phases describe the epistemological character of each sequence.

capacity.answers: What can the player do here?
capacity.output: Interaction depth available at each point — L1 Observe through L6 Embody
capacity.notes: The capacity ladder describes growing player agency. Not every sequence uses every level.

artifacts.question: What objects does the player encounter?
artifacts.output: Procedural Node3D scenes + registry JSON + map placement
artifacts.relationship: The things in the world that demonstrate each algorithm visually and interactively. Hazards interact with them, Catalyst transforms them, Capability lets the player manipulate them.

discovery.summary: 723 artifacts across 38 modular registries. 119 GDScript files, 107 artifact directories. Strong foundation — every sequence has artifacts.
existing_systems: artifacts/registry/ — 38 JSON registry files (wavefunctions 131, randomness 106, cellular_automata 41, qfep 35, arrays 34, living_paper 34)
managers/GridArtifactRegistry.gd — name-to-scene resolution engine
artifacts/artifact_spatial_contracts.json — directional profiles, clearance, interaction modes
gaps: Some registries have artifacts without map_ready flags
Not all artifacts have map_sequences assigned

hazards.question: What challenges and relationships evolve?
hazards.relationship: Creatures that shift between foe and friend as understanding deepens. They inhabit the Ecosystem, react to Artifacts, and are affected by the Catalyst.

discovery.summary: 19 hazard types with origami-based morphology. 59 GDScript files, 26 directories. HazardManager autoload manages type gating, personality progression (foe→friend), and spawner behavior.
existing_systems: managers/HazardManager.gd — autoload singleton, reads soft_stages.json hazards section, personality progression, spawner behavior gating
hazards/ — 26 creature directories (miura_crawler, kresling_spire, waterbomb_hopper, armadillo, kaleidocycle, scissor_stalker, octapod_crawler, etc.)
artifacts/registry/hazards.json — 19 registered hazard types with map_ready flags
hazards/becoming_catalyst/ — catalyst tool (transmutation link to hazards)
hazards/force_field/ — dual-nature zone (hazard is also medicine)
maps/soft_stages.json — defines hazard unlock_types, spawner_behavior, personality_shift, max_concurrent per sequence
gaps: Befriend mechanics defined in data but creature scripts not yet consuming HazardManager personality
Loving_triangle companion partially built but evolution not wired

catalyst.question: How does the player's tool grow?
catalyst.output: Crystal ability modes — one new mode per sequence, wired into becoming_catalyst.gd
catalyst.relationship: The player's single evolving tool. Each mode transforms how they interact with Artifacts and Hazards. The mode vocabulary mirrors the Capacity ladder.

discovery.summary: 10 crystal modes with projectile system. Core catalyst complete — modes unlock per sequence. CatalystCapabilityManager bridges mode_unlocked signal to player capabilities.
existing_systems: hazards/becoming_catalyst/becoming_catalyst.gd — main class (XRToolsPickable), 10 modes defined, emits mode_unlocked signal
hazards/becoming_catalyst/modes/ — 10 mode factories + 10 projectile behaviors
hazards/becoming_catalyst/catalyst_visual.gd, catalyst_projectile.gd — visual/projectile base
hazards/loving_triangle/ — companion entity (relational transformation)
managers/CatalystCapabilityManager.gd — listens to mode_unlocked, bridges to hand verbs and capacity ladder
gaps: Only 10 of 19 sequences have catalyst modes defined
Loving_triangle companion evolution mechanics not wired
Mode unlocking tied to sequence completion but gating not fully tested

capability.question: What interactions become possible?
capability.output: VR mechanics, tools, abilities — the player's expanding vocabulary of actions
capability.relationship: The agency layer. Capabilities enable the player to use the Catalyst on Artifacts within the Ecosystem. Tied directly to the Capacity Ladder levels.

discovery.summary: CatalystCapabilityManager autoload bridges catalyst modes to hand verbs and capacity ladder. VR interactable library complete. 19 soft stages define hand_verbs, capacity_level, movement_abilities per sequence.
existing_systems: managers/CatalystCapabilityManager.gd — autoload singleton, dual-listen (sequence_completed + mode_unlocked), capacity ladder L1-L6, hand verb gating
maps/soft_stages.json — defines capacity_level, hand_verbs, catalyst_mode, movement_abilities per sequence
interactables/ — sliders (horizontal, plane, axis, time, smooth), push buttons, dials, joysticks (snap/smooth/zero), levers (snap/smooth/zero)
interactables/slider_horizontal.gd — API: slider_moved signal, get/set_normalized_value(), set_param_name()
player/PlayerCustomization.gd, WristStatsDisplay.gd, pickup_xp_listener.gd, stuck_detector.gd
gaps: Movement providers not yet checking is_movement_available()
Capacity ladder gating is opt-in — existing interactables work without modification

ecosystem.question: How does the world respond to understanding?
ecosystem.output: Environment scenes — vegetation, terrain, ambient FX, world-state changes
ecosystem.relationship: The world itself evolving. Ecosystem changes are triggered by sequence progression and make the lab feel alive. Hazards live here, Artifacts are placed here.

discovery.summary: EcosystemManager autoload manages progressive allow-flag system. Nature system demo with 4 kingdoms exists. 19 soft stages define allow_flags, kingdoms, vegetation density, and terrain mode per sequence.
existing_systems: managers/EcosystemManager.gd — autoload singleton, is_allowed() flag queries, kingdom/terrain/vegetation config, listens to sequence_completed
maps/soft_stages.json — defines allow_flags, nature_kingdoms, vegetation_density, terrain_mode, ambient_preset per sequence
algorithms/nature_system/demo/ — nature_system_demo.tscn with DNA-based procedural generation (4 kingdoms + hybrid)
algorithms/nature_system/morphology/ — flower_morphology.gd, tree_morphology.gd, creature_morphology.gd, fungus_morphology.gd
artifacts/registry/computational_biology.json — 6 biology artifacts
artifacts/registry/lsystems.json — 8 L-system tree/growth artifacts
artifacts/perlin_terrain/ — noise-based terrain generation
artifacts/ecosystem_ca/ — cellular automata ecosystem simulation
gaps: Nature system morphology not yet querying EcosystemManager.is_allowed()
Terrain generators not yet consuming terrain_mode from EcosystemManager
Dynamic vegetation spawning per density config not implemented
Ambient preset changes not wired to SoundBank

capacity_ladder.name: Observe
capacity_ladder.description: Watch phenomena unfold, walk around objects, read clipboards

capacity_ladder.name: Touch
capacity_ladder.description: Grab and examine objects, feel haptic feedback, objects react to presence

capacity_ladder.name: Manipulate
capacity_ladder.description: Edit vertex positions, solve snap puzzles, draw traces

capacity_ladder.name: Construct
capacity_ladder.description: Build shapes from components, multi-step puzzles, create patterns

capacity_ladder.name: Control
capacity_ladder.description: Manipulate parameters (sliders), tune lambda and phi, affect world behavior

capacity_ladder.name: Embody
capacity_ladder.description: You ARE the parameter, movement is input, world responds to body

global_arc.name: Empty Lab
global_arc.description: Initial hub with three teleporters, minimal lighting, single rotating cube

global_arc.name: Perception Shift
global_arc.description: Color changes how the world reads — not just the objects under study

global_arc.name: Environmental Entropy
global_arc.description: Randomness becomes environmental, pushing the lab away from purely fixed demonstrations

global_arc.name: Ecology Emerges
global_arc.description: Rule-based life reads as ecology rather than single artifacts

global_arc.name: Recursive World
global_arc.description: The environment begins scaling itself recursively, world structure becomes self-similar

global_arc.name: Living Matter
global_arc.description: Morphogenesis makes matter feel alive and reactive

global_arc.name: Collective Creatures
global_arc.description: Collective agents arrive as creature-scale behavior

global_arc.name: Adaptive World
global_arc.description: Evolutionary systems become home for new creatures and world mutation

global_arc.name: Contradictory World
global_arc.description: The world carries contradiction directly, no longer a stable formal shell

global_arc.name: Tunable Becoming
global_arc.description: Evolution shifts from authored content to parameterized becoming

sequence_beats.color: Perception starts changing the world-read itself rather than just the object under study.
sequence_beats.randomness: Entropy becomes environmental and starts pushing the lab away from purely fixed demonstrations.
sequence_beats.cellularautomata: Rule-based life starts to read as ecology rather than as a single artifact.
sequence_beats.fractals: The environment begins scaling itself recursively, so world structure becomes visibly self-similar.
sequence_beats.lsystems: Plant-like branching and growth become explicit spatial actors in the world.
sequence_beats.softbodies: Morphogenesis is folded into softbodies, making matter itself feel alive and reactive.
sequence_beats.swarmintelligence: Collective agents arrive as creature-scale behavior rather than isolated objects.
sequence_beats.machinelearning: Adaptive and evolutionary systems become a plausible home for new creatures and world mutation.
sequence_beats.foundationscrisis: The world stops behaving like a stable formal shell and starts carrying contradiction directly.
sequence_beats.qfeplaboratory: The environment becomes tunable, so evolution shifts from authored content to parameterized becoming.
